search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches of issuer materials, investor-presentation references, and secondary reporting found an issuer statement supporting the surfactant-supplier claim, but no ranking data or defined denominator that resolves the normal-paraffin leadership atom.
The surfactant-raw-material ranking is stated by the issuer, without a defined market boundary or disclosed comparison basis.
The normal-paraffin leadership description appears in secondary reporting, but available evidence does not specify a ranking, market denominator, or units.
Issuer disclosures about normal-paraffin production and Asian customers establish activity, not leadership.
